question: A car covers the first 35 km in 15 minutes and the next 45 km in 25 minutes. What is the average speed of the car?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Distance = 35 + 45 = 80 km

Total Time = 15 + 25 = 40 minutes

Average Speed = (Total Distance ÷ Total Time) × 60

Average Speed = (80 ÷ 40) × 60 = 2 × 60 = 120 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 120 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First distance (d₁) = 35 km, Time (t₁) = 15 minutes

Second distance (d₂) = 45 km, Time (t₂) = 25 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2d2477107c116e46e6dc62e457d007ad89762e4476d049a1504213b85531a38.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total distance = 35 km + 45 km = 80 km

⇒ Total time = 15 min + 25 min = 40 minutes

⇒ Converting time into hours: 40 minutes = 40 ÷ 60 hours = 2 ÷ 3 hours

⇒ Average Speed = 80 ÷ (2/3)

⇒ Average Speed = 80 × (3/2)

⇒ Average Speed = 40 × 3 = 120 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 120 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed (Equal Distances)

If a car covers two equal distances at speeds x and y, the average speed is given by (2 × x × y) ÷ (x + y).

Speed Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, relative speed = S₁ − S₂. When they move in opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.</p
